FN-HLGV383-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 96
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/18/2025
Senate Bill 96 as introduced could increase receipts to the Department of Revenue by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the increase in additional salvage certificates of title
issued under the provisions of this bill.
Page 1
